description: 2 tactical challenges for Black in the Elephant Gambit. Strike with 2...d5!? and seize the center.

drills.briefExplanation: 2...d5! 3.exd5 e4! 4.Qe2 Nf6 — sacrifice the pawn for a mobile center and open lines.
drills.description: Black to play. White plays 2.Nf3 — answer with the Elephant 2...d5!.
drills.explanation: The Elephant Gambit: Black meets 2.Nf3 with the shocking 2...d5!, sacrificing a pawn for the initiative. After 3.exd5 e4! the knight must move, and 4.Qe2 Nf6 gives Black a dream gambit position — open lines, a central wedge, and fast development. White's extra pawn is weak; Black's activity is lasting.
drills.name: The Elephant Charge

drills.briefExplanation: 4...Nf6 5.dxe4 Nxe4 6.Qe2 Bb4+! — the knight outpost, then the pin.
drills.description: Black to play. White undermined with 4.d3 — develop and take back in the center.
drills.explanation: Against the careful 4.d3, Black keeps the gambit spirit: 4...Nf6 develops, and after 5.dxe4 Nxe4 the knight lands on a superb central outpost. After 6.Qe2 Black plays 6...Bb4+!, developing with check — White must respond, the e4 knight dominates the center, and Black's activity fully compensates the pawn.
drills.name: The e4 Outpost
